title: Lost in Tokenization: Fundamental Trade-offs in Graph Tokenization for Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.22471v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformers have become a central architecture for graph learning, but their application to graphs requires first choosing a tokenization: a graph-to-token map that determines which structural information is exposed at the input. In this work, we show that this choice is a fundamental component of transformer expressivity. We examine three tokenizations that serve as building blocks for many existing graph tokenizations: spectral, random-walk, and adjacency tokenizations. We prove that different tokenizations induce distinct depth regimes: the same graph computation may be realizable by a shallow transformer under one tokenization, while requiring substantially larger depth under another. For example, we prove that random-walk tokenization is lossy for any walk length, making it impossible in general to recover the graph from it, and that while spectral tokenization is lossless, it is ill-conditioned for local tasks. translated_title: 迷失于标记化：Transformer图标记化中的基本权衡
translated_abstract: Transformer已成为图学习的核心架构，但将其应用于图需要首先选择一种标记化方式：即一个从图到标记（token）的映射，它决定了在输入端暴露哪些结构信息。在本工作中，我们证明这一选择是Transformer表达能力的一个基本组成部分。我们研究了三种作为许多现有图标记化方法基础构件的标记化方式：谱标记化、随机游走标记化和邻接标记化。我们证明不同的标记化会诱导出不同的深度机制：同一个图计算在某种标记化下可由浅层Transformer实现，而在另一种标记化下则需要显著更大的深度。例如，我们证明随机游走标记化在任意游走长度下都是有损的，因此通常无法从中恢复图本身；而谱标记化虽然是无损的，但对局部任务却是病态的。我们进一步表明……
tldr: 该论文证明图标记化方式的选择是Transformer表达能力的基本决定因素——谱、随机游走与邻接三种标记化会诱导出截然不同的深度需求，其中随机游走标记化在任意游走长度下均有损，谱标记化虽无损但对局部任务呈病态。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the choice of graph tokenization is a fundamental determinant of transformer expressivity: spectral, random-walk, and adjacency tokenizations induce distinct depth regimes, with random-walk tokenization being lossy for any walk length and spectral tokenization lossless but ill-conditioned for local tasks.
